d: The OCC crew continues its ambitious NASA tribute motorcycle build, bringing the wonders of space exploration into custom bike design. Paul Jr. works on the intricate Earth globe details that add a distinctive touch to the Space Shuttle-inspired chopper. Meanwhile, the team draws inspiration from the Space Shuttle Discovery launch as the project moves forward. Watch the motorcycle builders put their creativity and fabrication skills to the test in this exciting episode of American Chopper. Catch American Chopper Season 3 Episode 2 only on discovery+ India.
